name: Shion ~Zankoku na Mahou no Tenshi~
original_name: シオン ～残酷な魔法の天使～
source:
Are you still... a human being?

The girl who adores cosplay appeared before you, but you did not know who she actually was. She was staring mutely at me. Unfriendly at all, though she was wearing funny clothes.
My life was completely changed by the encounter with the beautiful girl Sion who once attempted to kill me...

[From [url=http://eng.dlsite.com/work/=/link/work/aid/Nephrinn2/product_id/RE030949]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
你仍然……是人類嗎？

那個熱愛Cosplay的女孩出現在你面前，你卻不知道她的真實身分。她一言不發地凝視著我。雖然穿著滑稽的服裝，態度卻一點也不友好。
與詩音的邂逅徹底改變了我的人生。這名美麗的少女，曾想殺了我……

[摘自[url=http://eng.dlsite.com/work/=/link/work/aid/Nephrinn2/product_id/RE030949]DLsite English[/url]]
